claim: On Nightmare 1, three minutes of play mostly gets its damage from weapons picked up at level-ups and chests, not from the starting weapon.
evidence: L1.I1.G1: chip-shuriken 11864 and hot-potato 5528 against fry-knives 1886. L1.I1.G5: hot-potato 10186 against mezzaluna 1109. L1.I1.G3: tot-stampede 5970 against hash-boomerang 4763.

claim: Hot-potato and chip-shuriken are strong early picks at Nightmare 1, and the games that opened a chest in the first 2 minutes did best.
evidence: L1.I1.G1 (4 chests, 1195 kills) and L1.I1.G5 (hot-potato 585 kills, 951 total) survived. G2 and G4 opened no chest and died.

claim: Starting fry-knives with a bundle of low-damage passives (gravy-heart, chives, spud-sneakers, big-bowl) and no extra weapon died by 1:50. It dealt 646 damage in its first two minutes, against 8931 for plain fry-knives.
evidence: L1.I1.G2 against G1, same seed 11. This is one game, and its level-ups and routes differed (level 4 against 13).

claim: Tater-mines alone is weak in the opening and died at 2:03 without opening a chest. Only 204 shots fired and kills came slowly.
evidence: L1.I1.G4: 349 kills against about 1000 in the surviving games.

claim: Steam-vent at level 8 with root-network evolves into Pressure Cooker at the first chest, and the evolution deals heavy damage and keeps Tibo near full health.
evidence: L1.I2.G5: evolved at 63.8s, pressure-cooker 7148 damage and 337 kills, health 120/120 at 3:00, 56 damage taken.

claim: Starch-chain with hot-sauce evolves into Gratin Arc, which becomes the top damage source within 35 s of evolving. Seeker-sprouts + fertilizer + thick-skin was the highest-kill start (1333).
evidence: L1.I2.G2: gratin-arc at 2:27 dealt 8654 damage and 468 kills, with starch-chain 7746 before it; 5 chests opened, first at 0:41.

claim: At dashThreshold 0.5 the bot dashes rarely and only when health is already low. Whether more dashing helps is still unproven.
evidence: Full run: 8 dashes, all at 28% health or less (dash scores 51-57%), including 5 in the last 25 seconds; none stopped the boss or swarm. Earlier rows unchanged.

claim: Spud-cannon with hot-sauce, sprouting-eyes and starch-plating takes less damage and keeps health higher than spud-cannon alone.
evidence: L1.I2.G4 against G3, same seed 11: damage taken 68 against 113, health 112/120 against 57/120, kills 848 against 700.

claim: Hot-streak with movement passives (lean-lunch, tater-trot, masher-grip) deals heavy damage on Nightmare 1 while taking almost none, and needs hardly any action-model moves.
evidence: L1.I3.G2: hot-streak 9520 damage and 538 kills, 895 kills in total, 13 damage taken, 20 model-asked moves, health 114/120.

claim: Seed-potato with fertilizer evolves into Potato Patch at the first chest, and hash-hawk with bacon-bits evolves into Hash Harrier; both were among the top damage sources.
evidence: L1.I3.G4: potato-patch at 78.9 s dealt 5718 damage and 339 kills, hash-harrier at 150 s dealt 4468, 982 kills, health 120/120, level 13.

claim: A start with no chest opened in the first 90 s is the common thread of the early deaths. Tot-toss with gem-sling, magnet and grip died at 1:37 with zero chests.
evidence: L1.I3.G1: 0 chests, 122 kills, first chest listed 1:11, health under 25% from 1:05. Same pattern as L1.I1.G2 and G4 (see B2).

claim: Fry-sentry at level 8 with slow-cooker evolves into Fry Fortress at the first chest, and chip-shuriken picked up on the way plus gpu evolves into Kettle Cyclone. Together they were the strongest early build so far.
evidence: L1.I4.G4: fry-fortress at 56 s dealt 13942, kettle-cyclone at 134 s dealt 33566, 2588 kills, 27 damage taken, health 116/120, 7 boss chests and 8 elites killed by 3:00.

claim: A chest-first planner.goal did not fix the minute-5 gym either: it died at 5:20, sooner than the baseline (5:59) and the boss-knob game (5:29). Prompts and knobs alone have not fixed the Masher and elite wave.
evidence: L1.I6.G4 chest-first goal died at 5:20, L1.I5.G5 boss knobs at 5:29, L1.I4.G5 baseline at 5:59. All three used the same thin 98 hp build. The build was too weak for the Masher and elite wave, and prompts and knobs did not change that.

claim: Starch-chain 8 with hot-sauce (Gratin Arc) and hash-hawk 8 with bacon-bits (Hash Harrier) evolve at the first chest within 70 s and are top damage sources. Peel-phantom 8 with peel-out (Peel Poltergeist) is weak by comparison.
evidence: L1.I5.G1: gratin-arc at 69.7 s, 25566 damage, 1680 kills, health 116/120. L1.I5.G2: hash-harrier at 67 s, 13012 damage, 889 kills. L1.I5.G3: peel-poltergeist at 127 s, 3014 damage, 715 kills, 22 dashes at 0.2.

claim: Starting with a dash-only weapon such as peel-phantom, with nothing else to kill with, fails on Nightmare 1: almost no damage, no level-ups and no chests in 3 minutes.
evidence: L1.I6.G3: 44 kills, level 2, 662 damage, 0 chests, health 30/120, 5 dashes only after health fell below 45%. Compare L1.I6.G1 starch-chain, 1342 kills.

claim: Starch-chain is a strong fresh start on Nightmare 1: it evolves into Gratin Arc at the first chests and kills the most of any fresh start so far.
evidence: L1.I6.G1: gratin-arc at 134 s, 13465 damage, 1342 kills, 3 chests, health 110/132. L1.I5.G1 (loadout 8 + hot-sauce): gratin-arc at 70 s, 25566 damage, 1680 kills.

claim: On Nightmare 20 a max-level starting weapon with its catalyst does not survive the opening. Three elites of about 4000 hp arrive at 0:34-1:00, no chest is listed before then, and so no evolution happens.
evidence: L1.I8.G1 starch-chain 8 + hot-sauce died at 95 s, G2 fry-sentry 8 + slow-cooker at 36.6 s (3 Fry Fly elites), G3 hash-hawk 8 + bacon-bits at 73.5 s. All had 0 chests opened and 0 chests listed. L1.I8.G4 fresh starch-chain was at 53/120 at 90 s with 0 chests.

claim: The hard window on Nightmare 1 starts at about 2:00. The amusing boss, Sizzle Imp/Spittlebug elites and the 3:00 Mother of Beetles kill thin builds. The full run was at 21/120 health from 1:56 and died at 3:28.
evidence: Full run: 86 health lost to Sizzle Imp elites at 1:55-1:56, then 2-34 health to the end; Mother of Beetles killed it at 3:27 (41% left). Earlier rehearsal deaths at 2:27-3:28.

claim: Seeker-sprouts is the most reliable fresh start so far, but it only survives when it evolves or collects several chests. It reached 5:00 in 2 of 3 fresh games and died at 3:28 in the full run with no evolution.
evidence: L1.I9.G3 seed 23 lived (2800 kills, 6 boss chests). L1.I10.R3 lived (Overgrowth at 225 s, 9 boss chests). Full run TIBO10: died 3:28, 1 chest, seeker-sprouts 7/8 without Fertilizer, 1319 kills.

claim: The unchanged playbook with a random fresh start usually dies on Nightmare 1 before 3:30. The full run (seeker-sprouts) was a sixth data point: died at 3:28.
evidence: Rehearsal L1.I10.R1-R5: deaths at 147-208 s and one survivor. I9: 1 of 5 survived 300 s. Full run: 208 s.

claim: Fresh fry-knives, steam-vent, fry-sentry and tot-toss do not reliably reach their evolutions on a new seed. All four died between 2:01 and 3:12 in I9, with few chests (0-2) and weak extra weapons. The earlier seed-11 successes (Fry Fortress, Pressure Cooker) came from loadouts that were handed to the game, not from fresh play.
evidence: L1.I9.G1 fry-knives died 2:46 (2 chests), G2 steam-vent 3:12 (1 chest), G4 fry-sentry 2:01 (1 chest), G5 tot-toss 2:40 (0 chests). Compare L1.I4.G4 fry-sentry 8 + slow-cooker on seed 11 (loadout swapped in): Fry Fortress at 56 s, 2588 kills.

claim: The default planner.pick does not take a catalyst card even when a weapon is at 6/8 or 7/8 and its recipe is one card away. It spreads picks across new weapons and leaves a thin build.
evidence: Full run: Fertilizer offered 6 times (2:03-3:22) and rated 6-38%; Seeker Sprouts reached 7/8 at 2:35 but Overgrowth never evolved. Picks went to Root Cellar, Tater Twirl, Hot Streak, Peel Out and Spud Sneakers (five weapons at 1/8-2/8).

claim: At low health the default planner keeps choosing the evade goal (about 50%) over food and chests (20-48%). Tibo stays under 25% health for minutes, never eats food nearby and never opens listed chests.
evidence: Full run 1:56-3:27: 14 evade plans, 'Eat the food' 24-48% against evade 45-60%, 6+ chests listed (64-95 away at 2:12-2:30) and never opened, health gained 0 after 2:00, health 21/120 for most of the time.

claim: Fighting Sizzle Imp elites (exploders) on a chest at full health can cost most of Tibo's health in about 2 seconds. Every move was ruled out by the forecast, so the action model had no safe step.
evidence: Full run 1:55-1:56: -17, -17, -35, -17 hp (120 to 34) from Sizzle Imp while standing on a chest; all eight directions rated hurt about 3 or ruled out.
